logic.note: I2C at 0x68/0x69 (from the AD0 pin), WHO_AM_I 0x68, sleep at power-up, DEVICE_RESET, signal path reset, accelerometer and gyro full-scale ranges, temperature, and the data-ready flag. Readings saturate at the 16-bit limits like the real ADCs.

timing.note: A new sample is ready at every read; the sample rate divider, the digital low-pass filter delay and the FIFO are not modelled.

analog.note: Readings are the prop values exactly: no noise, bias, cross-axis sensitivity or temperature drift. A real sensor needs offset calibration.

power.note: Fixed 3.9 mA from VCC; answers only from 2.9 V. 4.7 kOhm pull-ups on SDA/SCL, 4.7 kOhm pull-down on AD0.

emulates: WHO_AM_I, PWR_MGMT_1 sleep/reset, ACCEL_CONFIG and GYRO_CONFIG full-scale ranges
Accelerometer, gyroscope and temperature output registers (big-endian, two's complement)
Address 0x68 or 0x69 from the AD0 pin voltage
Props or sim.setProps(...) from a physics step set the motion
doesNotEmulate: Digital motion processor (DMP), FIFO and interrupts on the INT pin
Sample rate divider and low-pass filter delay
Noise, offsets and drift (calibration routines converge instantly)
The auxiliary I2C bus (XDA/XCL) and pass-through mode
testOnRealDevice: Offset calibration: real gyros read a few °/s at rest
Vibration and noise on a moving robot (motors couple into the accelerometer)
